import bpy,json
from mathutils import Vector
print('SESSION',list(bpy.app.driver_namespace.get('terminal_craft',{}).keys()))
for cn in ['Harbor_Arrival_Landing','Coast_CraftWarehouse']:
 c=bpy.data.collections[cn]
 for o in c.objects:
  if o.type!='MESH':continue
  if cn=='Coast_CraftWarehouse' and not any(k in o.name for k in ['freight','barrel','mooring coil','Coil loose','Coil crossed','boathook','Bench','sack']):continue
  pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
  print(cn,o.name, [round(min(v[i] for v in pts),3) for i in range(3)],[round(max(v[i] for v in pts),3) for i in range(3)])
